families.name: Fibonacci two-phase transfer and rational numerators
families.structural_derivation: The two-step companion matrix is B=[[1,1],[1,2]]. Its resolvent on (0,1) has numerator (q,1-q) and determinant 1-3q+q^2. Scalar reconstruction is exact polynomial cross-multiplication.
non_claims: Finite agreement is not a universal proof.

families.name: Catalan quadratic OGF
families.structural_derivation: The coefficient equation of C=1+zC^2 is the Catalan convolution. The binomial closed form is checked independently in the stated range; its standard universal identification is an external source leaf.
non_claims: Finite agreement is not a universal proof.

families.name: Bell and Fubini EGF normalization
families.structural_derivation: Bell numbers are sums of Stirling numbers, Fubini numbers are sums of k! S(n,k). Expansion of exp(exp(z)-1) and 1/(2-exp(z)) uses Q coefficients and n! restoration. Universal combinatorial EGF identifications remain external source leaves.
non_claims: Finite agreement is not a universal proof.

families.name: Derangements EGF and polynomial recurrence
families.structural_derivation: Inclusion-exclusion is n! sum_{k=0}^n (-1)^k/k!. The product exp(-z)/(1-z) gives precisely that coefficient; the polynomial recurrence follows by grouping the sums.
non_claims: Finite agreement is not a universal proof.

families.name: Euler/secant and tangent EGF phase indexing
families.structural_derivation: Formal inversion of cos determines sec; tan=sin/cos. Positive secant coefficients occupy original factorials (2n)!; tangent coefficients occupy (2n-1)! with sequence index starting at 1. Phase splitting does not replace these by n!.
non_claims: Finite agreement is not a universal proof.

families.name: Partitions product vs pentagonal recurrence
families.structural_derivation: The product enumerator is independent of the pentagonal recurrence. Their equality is bounded evidence; the infinite Euler pentagonal product identity is an external source leaf, not proved by this run.
non_claims: Finite agreement is not a universal proof.

families.name: Apery polynomial-coefficient recurrence
families.structural_derivation: The defining binomial sum is computed independently; the displayed recurrence is tested exactly including n=0. Its universal creative-telescoping identity is an external source leaf.
non_claims: Does not prove the binomial recurrence for all n.
Polynomial recurrence coefficients are not a stationary FIR or constant transfer matrix.

families.name: Tribonacci and tetranacci fixed initials
families.structural_derivation: With zeros followed by one as initials, the OGF numerator is z^(order-1), denominator 1-z-...-z^order. The recurrence and initials determine the formal series uniquely.
non_claims: Finite agreement is not a universal proof.

families.name: General m-phase FIR routing
families.structural_derivation: In y_{mn+r}=sum_j h_j x_{mn+r-j}, residue matching forces h phase (r-s) mod m and one block delay exactly when s>r. This coefficient derivation proves the matrix formula for every finitely supported causal kernel.
non_claims: Finite agreement is not a universal proof.

families.name: FIR composition
families.structural_derivation: Both routes are the same finite double sum; distributivity and finite reindexing prove convolution associativity and polyphase-matrix composition universally.
non_claims: Finite agreement is not a universal proof.

families.name: Root-of-unity selector over characteristic zero
families.structural_derivation: For a primitive mth root zeta, m^{-1}sum_j zeta^{j(n-r)} is the residue indicator by the finite geometric sum. Computation uses exact cyclotomic quotient polynomials. The m inverse and primitive root hypotheses are essential.
non_claims: No claim in characteristics dividing m.
For EGF input the selected coefficient retains its original n! denominator.

families.name: Haar block sign and normalization
families.structural_derivation: With a=(e+o)/sqrt(2), d=(e-o)/sqrt(2), the transpose is the inverse and squared energy is preserved. Exact rational checks represent the common sqrt(2) symbolically by unnormalized sums/differences.
non_claims: Block pairing (x_2n,x_{2n+1}) differs from causal taps followed by even downsampling, which pairs (x_2n,x_{2n-1}).

families.name: Causal Haar pair alignment
families.structural_derivation: The causal taps (1,+/-1) followed by even downsampling have channel rows (1,+/-q), before sqrt(2) normalization. This is an exact indexing identity.
non_claims: Finite agreement is not a universal proof.

families.name: Streaming FIR state across chunk boundaries
families.structural_derivation: The retained state contains the preceding L-1 input samples. Induction on sample count makes each output equal to causal convolution. The run checks prefix outputs; tail flushing is a separate convention.
non_claims: Chunk-local reset is not a correct stateful implementation.
No FFT or floating-point error claim.

families.name: Integer-rate rational resampling
families.structural_derivation: Zero insertion puts x_k at Lk. Filtering and selecting output Mn gives y_n=sum_k h_(Mn-Lk)x_k by substitution. The same identity determines phase scheduling.
non_claims: An arbitrary finite kernel is not automatically an adequate anti-alias or anti-imaging filter.
This is a discrete algebraic resampling identity, not a continuous reconstruction theorem.

independence: No author generator imported; all enumerators constructed independently.
interpretation: Exact bounded execution plus separately stated structural derivations; no Lean certificate and no inference of universal proof from counts.
